name: 安定化アーティファクト解析
algorithm: Stabilization Artifact — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method detects video stabilization artifacts for forensic analysis:

1. **カメラ動き推定**: Global camera motion is estimated from background feature tracking — translation, rotation, and zoom components per frame. The raw (unstabilized) camera motion trajectory is reconstructed.

2. **Stabilizationアーティファクト検出**: Video stabilization smooths camera motion by applying compensating transforms. This produces characteristic artifacts: (a) cropped borders (stabilization reduces effective field of view), (b) warping residuals from rolling shutter correction, (c) motion blur inconsistent with the displayed (stabilized) motion.

3. **DoubleStabilization検出**: If a deepfake video is stabilized and then the original footage was also stabilized, double-stabilization produces characteristic artifacts: excessive border cropping, over-smoothed motion (unnatural zero jitter), and cumulative warping residuals.

4. **顔-Background動き一貫性**: After de-stabilization, the apparent motion of the face and background should be consistent with the same camera motion. If the face was generated and composited, its motion may not match the camera motion recovered from the background, creating a detectable motion inconsistency.

5. **StabilizationHistory分析**: The method estimates whether and how many times the video was stabilized. Each stabilization pass leaves a characteristic imprint on the motion trajectory (reduced high-frequency components). Multiple stabilization passes indicate the video has been processed multiple times — consistent with a manipulation → re-stabilization pipeline.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through stabilization artifact analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
